usageNote: 描述成长背景的超常用句型！which引导定语从句修饰place，讲自己故事时用，带点感慨味道～

examples.en: She grew up in a place which she knew nothing about before moving there.
examples.zh: 她在一个搬去之前对其一无所知的地方长大。

examples.en: I grew up in a place which I knew nothing about, yet it became my home.
examples.zh: 我在一个陌生的地方长大，但它最终成了我的家。
